{
  "execution_id": "EXEC-0005",
  "target": "WP-MVP-0003",
  "status": "completed",
  "summary": "Added deterministic, domain-separated source and document identity APIs with exact-byte SHA-256 provenance, governed-ID collision diagnostics, case-collision discovery diagnostics, and machine projections.",
  "changed_files": [
    "Cargo.lock",
    "Cargo.toml",
    "crates/monad-core/Cargo.toml",
    "crates/monad-core/src/discovery.rs",
    "crates/monad-core/src/identity.rs",
    "crates/monad-core/src/lib.rs",
    "machine/corpus.jsonl",
    "machine/documents/.eos-result-EXEC-0005.json.json",
    "machine/documents/Cargo.lock.json",
    "machine/documents/Cargo.toml.json",
    "machine/documents/crates/monad-core/Cargo.toml.json",
    "machine/documents/crates/monad-core/src/discovery.rs.json",
    "machine/documents/crates/monad-core/src/identity.rs.json",
    "machine/documents/crates/monad-core/src/lib.rs.json",
    "machine/graph.json",
    "machine/manifest.json"
  ],
  "validation": [
    {"command": "cargo fmt --all -- --check", "exit_code": 0, "summary": "Workspace formatting check passed."},
    {"command": "cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings", "exit_code": 0, "summary": "Workspace linting passed with warnings denied."},
    {"command": "cargo test --workspace --all-targets --all-features", "exit_code": 0, "summary": "All 29 workspace tests passed, including 6 identity tests and discovery case-collision coverage."},
    {"command": "git diff --check", "exit_code": 0, "summary": "No whitespace errors."},
    {"command": "python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write", "exit_code": 0, "summary": "Required machine projections regenerated."},
    {"command": "python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check", "exit_code": 0, "summary": "Machine projections verified synchronized."}
  ],
  "acceptance_criteria": [
    {"criterion": "US-008 stable Source IDs are equal across equivalent clean clones.", "status": "passed", "evidence": "identity::tests::source_identity_is_clone_independent_and_content_provenance_is_exact derives equal IDs from equal canonical path and kind."},
    {"criterion": "US-009 SHA-256/source/parser provenance is recorded and changes when consumed bytes change.", "status": "passed", "evidence": "SourceRecord::from_discovered records exact bytes, length, parser contract, discovery provenance, and SHA-256 golden vectors."},
    {"criterion": "US-010 duplicate governed identifiers produce collision diagnostics naming all sources.", "status": "passed", "evidence": "detect_duplicate_governed_identifiers deterministically returns sorted repository-relative locations; coverage verifies reordered input and namespace separation."},
    {"criterion": "content edits do not change Source ID solely because content changed.", "status": "passed", "evidence": "Identity test verifies changed content hashes with an unchanged SourceId."},
    {"criterion": "explicit governed Document IDs survive source-path moves; path-only Source IDs do not.", "status": "passed", "evidence": "document_ids_follow_explicit_and_path_only_rules covers both move cases."},
    {"criterion": "absolute host path, time, random IDs, inode/device data, and Git branch do not affect identity.", "status": "passed", "evidence": "Identity derivation accepts only canonical path/source kind or explicit identity components; serialization test checks no host-state fields."},
    {"criterion": "case-collision and symlink-alias fixtures are deterministic.", "status": "passed", "evidence": "Discovery case-collision test preserves case-sensitive paths and emits a sorted diagnostic; symlink identity test confirms one discovered semantic source."}
  ],
  "risks": [],
  "unresolved_issues": [],
  "proposed_commit_message": "feat(identity): add stable source and document identity"
}
